faqs.q: How long does a commercial metal roof last on an East Orange building?

runs.v: 40 to 80 years depending on the type, per InterNACHI and This Old House.

faqs.q: Do you need a permit for a commercial or multi-family metal roof in East Orange, NJ?

runs.v: Yes, past the 25% rule: repairing or replacing more than 25% of the roof area in 12 months on a commercial, multi-family, or attached building requires a permit under N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7.

faqs.q: What is the difference between standing-seam and exposed-fastener metal on an East Orange commercial roof?

runs.v: Standing seam hides its fasteners beneath the raised seam; exposed-fastener metal is screwed through the surface and cheaper to install.

faqs.q: Does a metal reroof on a Register-listed East Orange building need historic approval?

runs.v: Register listing alone places no restriction on a privately funded reroof, per the National Park Service; confirm local rules with the City of East Orange.

faqs.q: Should you repair or replace a commercial metal roof in East Orange?

runs.v: Repair localized damage. Replace standing seam when seam damage exceeds 25% or panel corrosion 20%, and exposed-fastener metal when 15 to 20% of fasteners corrode, per metal-roofing industry consensus; recurring leaks in one spot favor replacement, per HomeAdvisor.
